subject: Redwood pilot kickoff — security evidence & buying criteria
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medicore.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medicore.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood pilot kickoff — security evidence & buying criteria

Lena / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we stay aligned as you scope the pilot: 

1) Scope & success criteria (you): a 30-day pilot for embeddings + few-shot generation on clinical summaries; key metrics — 95th p50 latency < 400ms, token-cost target TBD;
2) Buying committee: economic buyer likely Tom (procurement) + Lena (product owner) + security reviewer (Isha) — please confirm other stakeholders;
3) Procurement path & timeline (you): Lena said procurement typically needs SOC 2 Type II, pen-test statement, and contract redlines before PO — rough ETA?;
4) Security evidence (action for us): we will provide SOC 2 summary, pen-test executive summary, audit-log retention policy, and answers on data deletion and key management.

Proposed next steps (can we agree?):
- Jordan: send SOC2 summary + pen-test statement + short answers for audit logs and retention by EOD Monday (11/9).
- Priya: I will map owner/responsibility matrix and priority sequence for evidence;
- Lena/Tom: confirm procurement milestones and any internal compliance form we should complete (SSO/SAML, KMS, BAA if required).

Attachments we can provide quickly: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (summary + scope), pen-test-exec-summary.txt (one-page), sample audit-log export (redacted) — please confirm if you need raw artifacts.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medicore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@medicore.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot kickoff — security evidence & buying criteria

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming:
- Procurement milestones: initial security review (this week), procurement kickoff + contract review (week of 11/15), PO expected before end of month if no major blockers. I'll attach our internal procurement timeline (attachment).
- Security needs: SOC 2 Type II summary (high priority), pen test executive summary, KMS & encryption details, and answers on retention/deletion. Our security team (Isha) will review artifacts and follow up with technical questions.

I attached "MedCore_procurement_timeline.xlsx" for visibility. Isha — can you flag any must-haves we should call out now?

—Lena
Lena Ortiz
Director, Product — Clinical Tools | MediCore Health

Attachment: MedCore_procurement_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Suggested stakeholder map & evidence priority

Quick internal note before we send artifacts to MediCore.
Prioritized evidence and owner: 
- SOC 2 Type II summary (owner: Jordan) — one-pager + link to more detailed report, call out scoping (prod vs. dev).
- Pen-test exec summary (owner: Jordan) — high level findings, remediation status.
- KMS / encryption details (owner: Ben) — key rotation, customer key options (bring-your-own-key).
- Audit log sample + retention policy (owner: Ben) — provide redacted sample and retention SLA.
- Data deletion policy & support for retention controls (owner: Priya) — short Q&A for procurement/security.

I recommend we package a 2-page "evidence checklist" and a Drive folder link for artifacts. If we send the SOC2 and pen-test summary first, that usually clears the initial security gate. I can own the checklist doc and the Drive layout if you want—will have a draft by Monday AM.

Priya
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medicore.com>, Isha Raman <isha.raman@medicore.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medicore.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Evidence bundle for MediCore pilot — SOC2 + pen-test summary

Hi Lena / Isha / Tom — attaching the initial evidence bundle for your review. See short notes below, and the Drive link for full artifacts.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, pen-test-exec-summary.txt
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-medcore-evidence

Notes: 
- SOC2 summary: scope covers production inference service, key control families called out (CC1, CC2), and auditor contact if you need formal receipt. Full report available under NDA — happy to coordinate.
- Pen test: executive summary only — shows no critical findings; remediation items listed with timelines. Full report available under NDA.
- Audit logs: we have daily retention by default and can provide a redacted sample on request.

If you need a specific artifact format for your security portal, tell us the file/upload requirements and we'll comply. Looking forward to Isha's review notes.

Jordan
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
Attachment: pen-test-exec-summary.txt (text, 6KB)
From: Isha Raman <isha.raman@medicore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medicore.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@medicore.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence bundle for MediCore pilot — SOC2 + pen-test summary

Thanks Jordan — helpful. A few follow-ups from the security team after a first pass: 
1) Audit logs: can you provide a redacted sample (one week) including timestamps, request IDs, and the fields you retain? Also confirm the immutable retention period and any export process.
2) Data deletion: need a short Q&A on deletion on-demand vs automated retention, and where backups may exist. Is there developer access to retained logs?
3) KMS: confirm if you offer customer-managed keys (BYOK) and the supported providers (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault).

Rough timeline request: if you can get the audit log sample + deletion Q&A + KMS doc by EOD Wednesday (11/11), we can move to procurement review the following week.

Isha Raman
Security Engineer | MediCore Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: ownerships and delivery timeline for MediCore asks

Jordan / Priya — I can own the audit-log sample and KMS write-up. Proposed plan: 
- Today (11/10): assemble redacted audit-log sample and short doc describing fields + retention (deliver to Drive).
- Tomorrow (11/11 EOD): provide KMS BYOK options and data deletion Q&A.
- Priya: once I drop artifacts in Drive, can you wrap into the "evidence checklist" and share the final folder link to MediCore?

If that timeline works, Jordan can reply to Isha confirming owners and providing the Drive link.

Ben
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
